items.title: Dreaming Spanish
items.creator: Pablo Román and team
items.why: The best-known Spanish CI channel: graded videos from superbeginner up, all in Spanish with visuals.
items.notes: Spans superbeginner to advanced; early videos are very slow. Sampled videos had no uploaded Spanish CC (auto-generated only). Mix of Spain and Latin American accents. Full library in its own paid app. Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Pocoyó Español - Canal Oficial
items.creator: Animaj / Zinkia
items.why: Preschool cartoon with a slow narrator and very simple words.
items.notes: Spain Spanish. Very little dialogue. Sampled videos had no captions at all. Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Plaza Sésamo
items.creator: Sesame Workshop
items.why: Sesame Street in Spanish: letters, numbers and simple everyday talk.
items.notes: Latin American Spanish, slow and clear. One of three sampled videos had uploaded Spanish (es-MX) CC. Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Peppa Pig Español Latino - Canal Oficial
items.creator: Hasbro / Entertainment One
items.why: Latin American dub of Peppa Pig: short family situations, clear narration.
items.notes: Slow, clear speech. Sampled videos had no uploaded Spanish CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Easy Spanish
items.creator: Easy Languages
items.why: Street interviews with real people in Mexico, Spain and elsewhere, with subtitles on screen.
items.notes: Real native speed but short answers. Spanish and English subtitles are burned in; no uploaded CC on sampled videos (auto only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Español con Juan
items.creator: Juan Fernández
items.why: Spanish teacher from Spain explaining and telling stories entirely in Spanish.
items.notes: Clear, expressive Spain Spanish, moderate speed. Uploaded Spanish CC on two of three sampled videos. Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Spanish After Hours
items.creator: Gabi
items.why: Venezuelan teacher teaching through stories and culture, mostly in Spanish.
items.notes: Uploaded Spanish (and often English) CC on all sampled videos. Moderate speed. Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Andrea la Mexicana
items.creator: Andrea
items.why: Comprehensible-input videos about everyday life in Mexican Spanish.
items.notes: Slow to moderate speed. Sampled videos had no uploaded Spanish CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Paulina Cocina
items.creator: Paulina
items.why: Easy recipes explained by an Argentine cook in friendly, clear Spanish.
items.notes: Rioplatense (Argentine) accent and voseo. Sampled videos had no uploaded Spanish CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Las Recetas de Laura
items.creator: Laura
items.why: Healthy Mexican recipes explained step by step at a calm pace.
items.notes: Mexican Spanish, calm speed. Uploaded Spanish (es-US) CC on two of three sampled videos. Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: superholly
items.creator: Holly
items.why: Lifestyle and DIY vlogs from a Mexican-American YouTuber in casual Spanish.
items.notes: Casual Mexican Spanish, moderate speed. Sampled videos had no uploaded Spanish CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Luisito Comunica
items.creator: Luis Arturo Villar Sudek
items.why: Hugely popular Mexican travel vlogger: fast, funny, slang-rich Spanish.
items.notes: Fast Mexican Spanish with slang; some swearing. Sampled videos had no uploaded Spanish CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: DW Documental
items.creator: Deutsche Welle
items.why: Full documentaries with clear narration in neutral Latin American Spanish.
items.notes: Measured narration; dubbed interviews. Sampled videos had no uploaded Spanish CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: BBC News Mundo
items.creator: BBC
items.why: BBC's Spanish service: news reports and explainers in neutral Latin American Spanish.
items.notes: Formal register, normal news speed. Uploaded Spanish (es-419) CC on all sampled videos - good for subtitle lookup. Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: DW Español
items.creator: Deutsche Welle
items.why: International news and analysis in Spanish at full broadcast speed.
items.notes: Formal news register. Sampled videos had no uploaded Spanish CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Cuentos en español (Global Storybooks)
items.creator: Global Storybooks / African Storybook (translations)
items.why: 40 illustrated stories tagged Nivel 1-5 with audio; level-1 stories have one short sentence per page.
items.notes: Enumerate from the index page or the level pages (/storybooks-spanish/stories/es/level1 ... level5). Story pages /stories/es/NNNN/ have the text as plain HTML. Split: 15 L1, 11 L2, 8 L3, 4 L4, 2 L5.

items.title: StoryWeaver (cuentos en español)
items.creator: Pratham Books
items.why: About 1,400 free picture books in Spanish with publisher levels 1-4, e.g. '¡Todo revuelto!' (level 1).
items.notes: Enumerate: https://storyweaver.org.in/api/v1/books-search?languages[]=Spanish&levels[]=1&per_page=24&page=N. Counts 2026-11-06: L1 474, L2 405, L3 259, L4 184 (1,438 total). Story metadata: /api/v1/stories/{slug}. The reader is a JS app (the /read API returns 401 without a session), so the page must be rendered before scoring. CC BY 4.0; mostly translated from English/Indian languages.

items.title: Pepper&Carrot
items.creator: David Revoy
items.why: Short open-licence comic episodes about a young witch and her cat, with little text per page.
items.notes: CC BY 4.0. Episode pages /es/webcomic/ep01_Potion-of-Flight.html etc. Text is in the images.

items.title: Planeta Fácil
items.creator: Plena inclusión España
items.why: Current news in validated 'lectura fácil' (easy-read) Spanish: short sentences, common words, one idea per line.
items.notes: Written for adults with intellectual disabilities but well suited to A2 learners. WordPress RSS at https://planetafacil.plenainclusion.org/feed/ (last build 2026-11-06). Sections: España, Mundo, Sociedad, Cultura, Tecnología. Also a podcast and TV.

items.title: News in Slow Spanish
items.creator: Linguistica 360
items.why: Weekly news at Beginner (A1-A2), Intermediate and Advanced levels, read slowly with transcripts.
items.notes: Subscription. Every lesson has a free portion of audio plus a partial transcript. Full stories are free in the companion Linguistica app. No RSS (/feed is 404).

items.title: Vikidia (enciclopedia para niños)
items.creator: Vikidia community
items.why: Encyclopedia articles written for 8-13-year-olds: simpler sentences than Wikipedia, on any topic.
items.notes: MediaWiki API: https://es.vikidia.org/w/api.php (e.g. action=query&list=random or list=allpages). Article HTML is fetchable.

items.title: Project Gutenberg (libros en español)
items.creator: Project Gutenberg
items.why: Hundreds of public-domain Spanish classics as HTML. Mostly 19th/early-20th-century literary language.
items.notes: Enumerate with the full catalogue CSV https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/feeds/pg_catalog.csv (columns Text#, Type, Issued, Title, Language, Authors, Subjects, LoCC, Bookshelves; filter Language=es). HTML text at https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/{id}/pg{id}-images.html. Some IDs are audiobooks with no HTML, so check Type=Text. Third-party JSON API: gutendex.com (slow).

items.title: Platero y yo
items.creator: Juan Ramón Jiménez
items.why: Very short vignettes (1-2 pages each) about a donkey, but lyrical with rural Andalusian vocabulary.
items.notes: Public domain in the US. The author died in 1958, so it may still be under copyright in some countries.

items.title: Cuentos de la selva
items.creator: Horacio Quiroga
items.why: Short animal stories written for children (1918): concrete plots, but jungle vocabulary and older Rioplatense phrasing.
items.notes: The Wikisource page is the 1918 edition's index ('La tortuga gigante' etc.); stories are on linked pages.

items.title: Cuentos de amor de locura y de muerte
items.titleEn: Stories of Love, Madness and Death
items.creator: Horacio Quiroga
items.why: Short, gripping stories, often recommended to advanced learners for their strong plots; literary vocabulary.
items.notes: Dark themes (death, illness, violence).

items.title: Wikisource en español
items.creator: Wikimedia community
items.why: A large library of public-domain Spanish texts as clean HTML, including fables and children's literature.
items.notes: MediaWiki API https://es.wikisource.org/w/api.php (list=search, categorymembers). Missing pages return HTTP 404, which helps validation. Many works are split into subpages from an index page.

items.title: Wattpad en español
items.creator: Wattpad
items.why: Huge free collection of amateur Spanish fiction in informal, dialogue-heavy, mostly young-adult language.
items.notes: Tag pages like /stories/español and /stories/fantasia. Quality varies a lot. Much romance, some mature content. Some chapters need login.

items.title: Culpa mía
items.creator: Mercedes Ron
items.why: Began as a Wattpad serial: very colloquial Spain Spanish and lots of dialogue; easy plot to follow.
items.notes: Mature: sex, violence, drugs. Book 1 of the Culpables trilogy; Amazon film 2023.

items.title: Maru es una cachorra
items.creator: Mojo
items.why: A gentle Korean gag webtoon about a girl who is really a puppy: short episodes, simple everyday lines.
items.notes: Official Spanish translation of a Korean original. Webtoon text is in images.

items.title: Mi novio, el nerd gigante
items.creator: fishball
items.why: One-page gag strips with one or two lines of everyday couple dialogue each.
items.notes: Translated from English (WEBTOON Original).

items.title: Las células de Yumi
items.creator: Donggeon Lee
items.why: A Korean slice-of-life about an office worker's feelings shown as cute 'cells'; everyday adult dialogue.
items.notes: Official translation of the Korean original (유미의 세포들). The French listing found is Season 3.

items.title: Batman: Aventuras de la familia Wayne
items.creator: DC x WEBTOON
items.why: Short, light family-comedy episodes; familiar characters make the context easy.
items.notes: DC Comics' WEBTOON Original, translated from English. Check the writer/artist credits on the series page before publishing.

items.title: APARI3NCIAS
items.creator: Taejun Park
items.why: A very popular Korean high-school drama with lots of slangy teen dialogue and fights.
items.notes: Violence and bullying. Over 500 episodes; ongoing.

items.title: Aun así
items.creator: Jeongseo
items.why: A Korean university romance with natural, emotional young-adult dialogue.
items.notes: Some sexual content (adult romance).

items.title: Lector omnisciente
items.creator: Sleepy-C / UMI / sing N song
items.why: A hit Korean fantasy; plenty of system-message and genre vocabulary, but the visual action supports the text.
items.notes: Violence. Creator credits are from the French page.

items.title: Mafalda. Todas las tiras
items.creator: Quino
items.why: Four-panel strips with short dialogue, a classic learners are told to read; Rioplatense voseo and 1960s political humour.
items.notes: Not legally free online. ISBN 9788426418760.

items.title: Pobre Ana
items.creator: Blaine Ray (TPRS Books)
items.why: A classroom graded novel built on a very small vocabulary, offered in present- and past-tense versions.
items.notes: A whole series exists (Pobre Ana bailó tango, Pobre Ana moderna...).

items.title: Short Stories in Spanish for Beginners
items.titleEn: Short Stories in Spanish for Beginners
items.creator: Olly Richards (Teach Yourself)
items.why: Eight graded stories for A1-B1 with chapter summaries, glossaries and quizzes; a top learner recommendation.
items.notes: ISBN 9781473683259. Volume 2 and an intermediate book exist. Audiobook available.

items.title: Manolito Gafotas
items.creator: Elvira Lindo
items.why: A funny children's novel narrated by a Madrid boy: short chapters, but Spain-specific slang (retailers say B1).
items.notes: Audiobooks exist. Colloquial peninsular Spanish.

items.title: Harry Potter y la piedra filosofal
items.titleEn: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
items.creator: J.K. Rowling (trans. Alicia Dellepiane)
items.why: The most common 'first real novel'; known plot helps, but learners say about B1-B2 is needed to read it comfortably.
items.notes: Peninsular translation (Salamandra).

items.title: Complete Spanish
items.creator: Language Transfer
items.why: Audio course that builds sentences by thinking through the language's structure from zero; widely recommended as the best free first course.
items.notes: step 1. Completely free, donation-funded (site: 'no price tags'). Available via LT app, SoundCloud, YouTube, and zip download. Taught in English. Language Transfer also has an English course for Spanish speakers (/ingles) - useful for Spanish-native users of the extension.

items.title: Coffee Break Spanish
items.creator: Coffee Break Languages
items.why: Level 1 (absolute beginner, A1-A2) podcast: a teacher and learner chat through phrases and grammar step by step.
items.notes: step 3. Podcast episodes free in podcast apps; paid one-time course per level adds notes, videos, exercises (Level 1 course = 40 lessons). Coffee Break TV ($24.99/mo) is for intermediates - skip. Taught in English. First Steps link listed on the official site, not fetched separately.

items.title: Butterfly Spanish
items.creator: Butterfly Spanish
items.why: Free YouTube lessons on pronunciation, grammar and vocabulary with clear explanations for beginners.
items.notes: step 3: explained grammar/pronunciation videos. Channel says lessons are free and for all levels. English explanations.

items.title: BBC Languages - Spanish
items.titleEn: BBC - Learn Spanish with free online lessons
items.creator: BBC
items.why: Archived but still online: a Spanish alphabet/pronunciation guide, 'Talk Spanish' video introduction and the 'Mi Vida Loca' beginner drama course.
items.notes: reference only. Site is mothballed (no updates); some activities may rely on old media players and not work. Guide: /languages/spanish/guide/alphabet.shtml; Talk Spanish: /languages/spanish/talk/; Mi Vida Loca: /languages/spanish/mividaloca/ (pages load, media playback not tested).

items.title: Duolingo Spanish
items.creator: Duolingo
items.why: The most widely used free app; short daily lessons build basic vocabulary and habit.
items.notes: daily habit. Free app/web, optional subscription. Verified URL is for English speakers; Spanish is offered from many other base languages in the app.

items.title: LingoDeer
items.creator: LingoDeer
items.why: App with grammar notes in each lesson; offers both Spain and Latin American Spanish courses.
items.notes: daily habit alternative. Freemium (subscription for full access; price shown only as promo). Site menu in 16 languages (en, de, es, fr, id, it, ja, ko, pl, pt, ru, th, tr, vi, zh-Hant, ar); base-language availability per course not confirmed.
